customManagers.description: Track pinned container images in Justfile variables that carry a tag and a digest.
Track pinned container images in Justfile variables that carry only a digest (the bst2 runner).

BuildStream elements: any value annotated with a '# renovate:' comment on the preceding line. Covers pinned tarball URLs and tool versions. Commit/digest refs that Renovate cannot resolve are refreshed by `just track` instead.
Track pinned tool versions in workflow env vars.

packageRules.description: Automerge GitHub Actions digest/pin/patch/minor bumps once checks pass. These SHAs run in jobs holding packages:write and id-token:write, so this is the deliberate trade for zero dependency toil.
BuildStream pins (elements/ and Justfile container images) never automerge: a ref or digest must be refreshed with `just track` (which runs `bst source track`) and the image must build first.

Hold the build runner at Ubuntu 24.04: projectbluefin/actions' setup-runner asserts ubuntu-24.04 when adding its resolute apt source, so 26.04 fails the build. Docker versioning cannot express a range, so the runner update is disabled outright; re-enable once upstream supports 26.04.
A major crossing always waits for a human — never automerge one. Last matching rule wins, so keep this rule last.
